games.desc: Defend your magical city from an enemy army in an epic fantasy game of swordfights, political maneuvering, and romance! Will you prove worthy of your crown?

games.name: Move Together
games.desc: Кооперативная игра для 5 игроков! Укладывайте вещи в багажник авто на разных локациях, решая головоломки. Все предметы должны поместиться, чтобы двери закрылись. Ищите секреты, соревнуйтесь на скорость с друзьями или в одиночку и станьте лучшими!

games.name: Total War Battles: KINGDOM
games.desc: The Cross Platform, bite-sized Total War – Easy to pick up, quick-fire strategy gaming sessions where you can expand your realm and fight battles no matter which device you choose.

games.name: BzzzController
games.desc: BzzzController is a simple program that allows you to turn on vibration on your gamepad and keeps it on even when you minimize the window, in case you need your gamepad to vibrate for whatever reason. BzzzController was tested with an Xbox One controller and can control up to 4 gamepads.

games.name: Zombie Panic! Source
games.desc: Погрузитесь в мир зомби апокалипсиса с Zombie Panic! Source: командным survival-horror шутером от первого лица!

games.name: LET IT DIE
games.desc: Experience all the heart-thumping action with a silky-smooth frame rate and ultra-high resolution. How you make the best of the weapons, armor, and items at your disposal will determine your fate in the ever-changing Tower of Barbs!

games.name: Mechaneer Resta's Grand Adventure
games.desc: One day, the robots around town go out of control and start running amok. It's up to Resta and her good friend Curie to identify the source of the disturbance and save everyone!

games.name: Toro
games.desc: TORO, a bullfighting arcade video game where you will be able to challenge the bravest bulls ever digitalized in the most famous bullrings across the world. Become the number one bullfighter, or take control of the bull in special mini games to prove your skills, and teach the bullfighters a lesson!

games.name: LOW VALUE JOB
games.desc: LOW VALUE JOB is a dystopian job-simulation game where you sort scattered bolts, nuts, and washers by type. Pick up each part, examine it, and classify it accurately. Play solo to steadily raise your score, or compete online with players around the world to test your sorting skills.

games.name: Zombie Defense: The Last Frontier
games.desc: Одиночная и кооперативная игра для 4 игроков, вы - боец подразделения специального назначения, ваша задача - уничтожать волны зомби, занимая удобные позиции и используя тактику

games.name: Clicker Guild
games.desc: Clicker Guild is a beautifully animated free to play clicker, with a special take on the genre by adding randomly generating loot for the characters.

games.name: Warehouse Simulator
games.desc: Manage your own warehouse and take care of receiving and sending orders. Become an expert handling the forklift and use it to do different tasks with it. Do missions transporting goods to different destinations with your truck.

games.name: Code 3: Police Response
games.desc: Code 3 is a tactical police based first person shooter developed for the PC made by police and police support personnel.

games.name: New Frontier Days ~Founding Pioneers~
games.desc: "New Frontier Days ~Founding Pioneers~" is a town-building simulation game, where you command your pioneers to colonize a new land.

games.name: Purgatory II
games.desc: In this indie strategy game, command your mighty legions of hellish creatures! Fight your way through the real world and seek vengeance for those who have wronged you!

games.name: Sky Hunter
games.desc: Sky Hunter является игрой поединка вертолетов типа 3D, управление простое и сражение интерасное жестокое. Макс. поддержать 8 человек сражаться на поле боя. 5 тематических карт отобраны.

games.name: Lost Astronaut
games.desc: Control a spaceship and attempts to land safely on blue platforms. You can move the ship and burn fuel to fire a thruster, attempting to gently land on marked areas. A new scenario is loaded after every successful landing.

games.name: Dragons and Titans
games.desc: Dragons and Titans — это динамичная игра в стиле DOTA с элементами классических RPG. Более 30 уникальных драконов и 30 единиц легендарного оружия. Улучшайте драконов и куйте оружие, наращивая свое могущество.

games.name: Hunting Unlimited 1
games.desc: Spot your prey quickly then get into position for the ultimate in hunting action! Packed with over 220 missions – including the bonus Master Campaigns – pursuing 5 species of game in 5 rich environments, Hunting Unlimited is the innovative original hit that started a long running series!

games.name: METAL SLUG DEFENSE
games.desc: "METAL SLUG" возвращается в виде новой стратегической игры на Steam!

games.name: GASP
games.desc: This game takes place in the same universe as our upcoming tittle Secluded; you take control of a lone astronaut that lands on the surface of a planet, miles away from the other members. And it’s your job to meet up with the other astronauts.

games.name: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms
games.desc: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms — это стратегия в мире Dungeons & Dragons, где воители из разных уголков мультивселенной D&D отправляются в грандиозные приключения.

games.name: Failure simulator
games.desc: Waste time like in real life, do absolutely nothing watch your screen while you wonder were did things go wrong in your life. A simulation game that you do nothing just look at your screen. A complete waste of time and money.

games.name: Depression Quest
games.desc: Depression Quest is an interactive fiction game where you play as someone living with depression. You are given a series of everyday life events and have to attempt to manage your illness, relationships, job, and possible treatment.

games.name: Vampire Hunter: Nightrise
games.desc: Ты заперт в готическом замке вампира. Найди потайные ходы и доберись до хозяина замка до наступления Nightrise. Круши мебель на колья, пришпиливай тварей к стенам арбалетом для кольев и береги веру — она даёт тебе силу.

games.name: Realm Royale Reforged
games.desc: Станьте лучшим чемпионом в Realm Royale! Наделите вашего персонажа смертоносными способностями и оружием. Исследуйте волшебный мир верхом и спаситесь от губительного тумана. Вас ждет впечатляющая королевская битва с участием 100 игроков!

games.name: Manager can be Tough!: Case of the Kidnapped Waitress
games.desc: Hack, slash, and blast your way through hordes of beastly enemies and powerful bosses to rescue your beautiful waitress in this sexy 2D Side scrolling action game!

Ролевая игра с нажатием и щелчком, полная головоломок и жестоких врагов. Вы можете решить быть добрым или злым в игре. Ваши решения определят ваше будущее. Используйте свои предметы разумно или понесите последствия. “Пока я думал, что учусь жить, я учился умирать”. - Леонардо да Винчи

games.name: Edge of Twilight – Return To Glory
games.desc: "Edge of Twilight - Return to Glory" - приключенческая игра от 3 лица в постапокалитическом стимпанковом фэнтэзи сеттинге, которая поведает о мире, разделённом на два измерения: дневное и ночное.

games.name: Epic Battle Fantasy 3
games.desc: Epic Battle Fantasy 3 is a silly turn-based JRPG, full of useless NPCs, rabid cats, childish humor, unreasonably large weapons, anime boobs, and other nonsense. And it's totally free!

games.name: Дорогой Король Величество
games.desc: Dear Princes and Princess, a legendary kingdom awaits your inheritance. Your people eagerly await your wisdom and courage. Yet, this journey is fraught with challenges; obstacles will test your resolve. Do not betray the trust your people have in you. Lead them to true greatness!

games.name: Dragon Nest
games.desc: Dragon Nest is an online action role-playing game that combines the blazingly fast combat and visually stunning attacks of a console game with the epic story and role-playing elements of classic MMORPGs.

games.name: Future Proof
games.desc: Quirky, top-down puzzle adventure game. You’re trapped in a 12-minute time loop. Try to save yourself and a small town from destruction from a meteorite. Solve intuitive puzzles, interact with the people of the town, and discover the secrets of the town. Discover the 15 different endings!

games.name: The shaved ice shop
games.desc: Уютная хоррор-игра, в которой вы управляете лавкой с колотым льдом. Обслуживайте клиентов, предлагая колотый лед, кофе, молочные коктейли...

games.name: Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim
games.desc: At long last, the works of H.P. Lovecraft meet the medium of RPG in a spectacle of light and sound befitting an old western. Only this is set in New England. Meet interesting people! See astounding wonders! Enslave humanity! Go on one date side quest in a game subtitled a dating simulator!

games.name: Long Car Journey - A road trip game
games.desc: Traverse the never-ending desert searching for provisions. Look for fuel, fix the engine, pay attention to the battery, change the turbo charger! Explore abandoned buildings, sell the objects you find, check the condition of your car. Collect provisions and hide them at home!

games.name: Copa Petrobras de Marcas
games.desc: COPA PETROBRAS DE MARCAS is a 100% free official game simulating the thrill of competing wheel-to-wheel with models from various automakers in some of the main Brazilian race tracks.

games.name: Warfront Defenders
games.desc: The gameplay is inspired by famous last stands from some of history's deadliest conflicts, such as the Second World War and the Sino-Japanese War. A hybrid of Tower Defense and Real-Time Strategy with a lot of replay value.

games.name: Metal War Online: Retribution
games.desc: Fast Online Car Shooter. Unmatched dynamic shooter with a huge selection of futuristic technology! Millions of players.

games.name: OpenTTD
games.desc: OpenTTD - это экономический симулятор, в котором игроки зарабатывают деньги, перевозя пассажиров и грузы с помощью автомобильного, железнодорожного, водного и воздушного транспорта.

games.name: 8/8/88 Needle AL
games.desc: On the ominous date of 8/8/1888, the entire population of Needle, Alabama seemingly vanished, leaving behind only a haunting silence and an eerie sense of dread. A first-person psychological-horror drama.

games.name: Ragnarok Online 2
games.desc: Return to the beautiful and dangerous world of Midgard! Inspired by Norse mythology, the much-anticipated sequel to the groundbreaking Ragnarok Online has arrived! Immerse yourself in the new, but recognizable world of Ragnarok 2.

games.name: MARVEL Puzzle Quest
games.desc: Collect Marvel characters and upgrade your unstoppable squad in this epic Super Hero Puzzle RPG! Fight on the tactical Match-3 board where every move is crucial, and master head-to-head PvP tournaments alongside high-stakes events all year round!

games.name: Time of Dragons
games.desc: Это MMO-шутер, в котором вы сражаетесь на драконах, вооруженных ракетами и лазерами!

games.name: The Settlers Online
games.desc: Постройте свое средневековое королевство прямо сейчас в The Settlers Онлайн!

games.name: Black Squad
games.desc: Black Squad is a free-to-play military first-person-shooter. Players can master their skills and show off their strategies with a wide range of game maps, modes, and weapons to choose from. Join thousands of FPS players worldwide in one of the most played games on Steam!

games.name: Vom Drachentöten
games.desc: Ein klassisches Rollenspiel, reduziert auf den Zauber des alten Genres: Wortgewaltige Sprache. Fordernde Kämpfe. Drei, die einen Drachen töten – und was sie dazu führen mag. [German language only]

games.name: Water Festa
games.desc: Water Festa is a top-down shooter inspired by Thailand's Songkran water festival. You play as a mermaid girl, balancing wetness to remain human, dodge water to avoid becoming too wet, but seek it when dry. Expect a casual bullet hell experience as people continuously shower you.

games.name: Anno Online
games.desc: Anno Онлайн – это бесплатная градостроительная игра, которая позволяет заниматься развитием великолепных крупных городов в средневековом антураже.

games.name: Argo
games.desc: Окунитесь в головокружительные сражения в этой официальной, самостоятельной и БЕСПЛАТНОЙ версии Arma 3. Argo представляет собой хардкорный тактический шутер от первого лица, в котором вы сражаетесь с противниками на неограниченной местности, где каждый выстрел на вес золота.

games.name: Hypno-Mart
games.desc: A short visual novel about a stylish blonde-dyed part-timer who works the night shift.

games.name: Trenches VR
games.desc: Trenches VR is a psychological horror game where your microphone becomes part of the terror - enemies can hear your real-life breathing, whispers, or cries for help. Stay quiet, stay hidden… or they’ll come for you.

games.name: Wacky Burgers
games.desc: Wacky Burgers - это казуальная, милая игра в жанре point-and-click. Вы играете роль владельца бургерной, к которому приходит множество странных покупателей, и вы должны развивать свой магазин, продавая им еду.

games.name: Cabals: Card Blitz
games.desc: Build decks and fight auto-battles.

games.name: Beyond Enemy Lines: Operation Arctic Hawk
games.desc: Навигация, наблюдение, проникновение. Освободите заложника у торговца оружием, адаптируйтесь к погодным условиям, используйте ночные укрытия. Выбирайте свой стиль - палящее оружие или бесшумный убийца. Ваш выбор, ваше мастерство, ваша игра.

games.name: Monsters sandbox
games.desc: Многопользовательская игра с возможностью подключения по LAN или Internet. Боритесь против монстров в одиночку или совместно с друзьями. Находите оружие и патроны во время игры или купите их в магазине. Разные режимы игры.

games.name: Death Unphased
games.desc: Invent your own path! Phase through walls with your dash and blaze towards the exit. Death Unphased is a short experience fusing precision and puzzle platforming. Speedrun the smartest routes and aim to beat your fastest time in each level.

games.name: I AM RABBIT
games.desc: 3D Flatformer Cute Adventure Rabbit Game Traverse captivating landscapes from forests to cities, seas, skies, and even the moon itself ! Enjoy charming low-polygon graphics ! Overcome challenging traps !

games.name: My Liege
games.desc: As lord of the smallest noble house sworn to your Liege, you must lead your people and family through turmoil. In this choose your own adventure RPG, can you grow your influence while keeping neighbors from taking over thy lands? Pick everything from house name, sigil, and commands for your house!

games.name: Clicker Kingdom
games.desc: Кликай по золоту. Строй королевство. Стань непристойно богатым. Уютный средневековый idle-кликер с 8 гильдиями, 20 зданиями и 315 улучшениями. Вознесение. Престиж. Повтор. Даже твой Twitch-чат может войти в королевство. 50 достижений ждут, Ваше Величество.

games.name: Teddy Collector
games.desc: Not just luck, a skill-based claw machine with real physics, arcade minigames, and dozens of teddies to collect.

games.name: LuckCatchers
games.desc: "LuckCatchers" – массовая многопользовательская онлайн игра в мире магии и пара. Стань пиратом, торговцем, перевозчиком или производителем в этом недружелюбном мире, населенном драконами.

games.name: The Battle Of Mahjong
games.desc: You can only find out the fun of playing “Mahjong” by yourself, I'm sure you'll addicted to it. Don’t hesitate, come and join “ THE BATTLE OF MAHJONG”!

games.name: The Pillage
games.desc: A fast paced hack-n-slash arcade game where kidneys are harvested from everyone in your path.

games.name: страшная жена качестве HD
games.desc: You wake up in your house but there is a girl here. She said she is your new wife and you are the husband. But you don't have a memories about your marriage with her. Is it some kind of prank? Something is very creepy about her, say hello to your new scary wife!

games.name: Двуединое сознание: Враг из ниоткуда Коллекционное Издание
games.desc: Никогда еще наука не была так опасна! Смерть витает в воздухе... Звучит довольно зловеще, не так ли? Помогите детективам раскрыть новое дело!

games.name: Chinese Characters
games.desc: "Chinese characters" is an elimination and puzzle game, put the same three words into the bottom slot to eliminate, eliminate all the words to pass the level, the game should always pay attention to the lower level of the text.

games.name: Gigantic
games.desc: Gigantic – стратегический командный шутер, в котором персонажи сражаются бок о бок с громадными стражами. Лишь смелые и находчивые станут Гигантами!

games.name: missed messages.
games.desc: ‘goth gf’s iPhone’ airdrops you - accept or decline? A love/horror story about life, death, & memes.

games.name: Critical Damage
games.desc: "Critical Damage"-аркадный экшен, где мы управляем боевым роботом, уничтожая пришельцев на космической станции "Зенит-3".

games.name: Heroine's Quest: The Herald of Ragnarok
games.desc: Героиня должна выстоять против сил мороза и положить конец долгой зиме. Её мощь, магия и хитрость могут стать последней надеждой человечества. Heroine's Quest - гибрид Adventure/RPG в ретро-стиле, передающий атмосферу и дух классических игр.

games.name: CBO TD
games.desc: CBO TD is a build your own maze tower defense. Protect your castle from hordes of mobs with different classes of towers.

games.name: Eldevin
games.desc: Eldevin is the award winning indie story-driven Free to Play MMORPG (Massively Multiplayer Online Role Playing Game) from Hunted Cow Studios. Join thousands of other players and explore the mystical lands of Eldevin.

games.name: Hounimal
games.desc: 『Hounimal』 is a roguelite command battle RPG where you journey with Hounimal, a reliable companion and your home. Place colorful and powerful furniture to build the best Hounimal!

games.name: Gebub's Adventure
games.desc: Gebub finds himself in a large peaceful world, filled with colorful orbs and many creatures who need his help.

games.name: Cyberia 2: Resurrection
games.desc: Cyberia 2 combines blackout-inducing rail shooter action sequences with puzzle-solving and animated movies.

games.name: BLASK
games.desc: BLASK -— это уникальная игра-головоломка, в которой вы управляете окружающей средой, чтобы поразить все маркеры целей лазерами.

games.name: Midnight Shift
games.desc: Одна девушка работала на заправке в Висконсине, и во время одной полуночной смены с ней случилось непредвиденное.

games.name: LOGistICAL: USA - Wisconsin
games.desc: LOGistICAL: USA - Wisconsin is a large open-world, strategy, puzzle game where you transport different cargoes to complete all the towns throughout the state. Over 800 towns to complete including cities like Milwaukee, Madison, Green Bay and many, many more.

games.name: Vinterget
games.desc: Покорите вершину горы в этом коротком платформере. Используйте топорик, чтобы цепляться за поверхности, ловко проходя уровень за уровнем. Прорвитесь сквозь опасности заснеженной горы Винтергет.

games.name: Knight's Saga Evil Goblins
games.desc: Knight's Saga: Evil Goblins - захватывающая игра в жанре фэнтези, в мир вторглись злые гоблины, вы вступаете в роль отважного воина, отправившегося в опасное путешествие для их уничтожения. Вас ожидают захватывающие приключения и сражения во имя спасения королевства.

games.name: Space Mergers
games.desc: Space Mergers is a satisfying fast-paced puzzle game that encourages critical thinking. Combine blocks to create combos and gain points, reach the highest score you can! There is over a million different ways to play, enjoy some endless fun.

games.name: Scrapworks Simulator
games.desc: Начинайте как сборщик металлолома в Scrapworks Simulator и двигайтесь к созданию большого производственного цеха. Исследуйте окружающую среду, чтобы найти детали, спрятанные на земле, на фабриках и в заброшенных районах, и соединяйте собранные детали для создания продуктов в своей мастерской.

games.name: Magic Lantern
games.desc: "Волшебный фонарь VR" — это уютная виртуальная комната для всей семьи, в которой вы можете смотреть любимые сказки, играть, рисовать и весело проводить время. Совершите путешествие в волшебный завораживающий мир!

games.name: Star Fetchers
games.desc: Пролог к безумному приключению с гангстерами и конспирологическими теориями

games.name: Panda Roll
games.desc: Meet Pandara and Mulatta, the heroes who are looking forward to find the mighty Sun Bamboo, in order to cure Mulatta's mother. In this adventure you will control both at the same time, so that you can use their friendship and trust go through all the puzzles and difficulties to achieve their goals.

games.name: Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl
games.desc: Смешная многопользовательская игра Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl приносит праздничное настроение с абсурдным оружием. Соревнуйтесь с друзьями, жарьте их огнеметом и шлепайте гигантской рыбой. Погрузитесь в этот веселый хаос прямо сейчас!

games.name: Hertz
games.desc: Launch into a fierce roguelite action in this top-down twin-stick shooter with bombs! In a robotic world, control Lizzy and their team of unlockable beasty bots in a quest for upgrades. But beware, needed resources are guarded by swarms of Steel Sentinels. Survive them to craft synergistic builds.

games.name: Rhythm Reunion - Indie Dating Sim Visual Novel
games.desc: The band is getting back together! Haven't you heard?! 'Summer Vacation' is reuniting for one last gig! Take part in this artistically diverse visual novel as you explore the new lives of each of the old band members, all whilst you convince each of them to return to the lime light!

games.name: Falco Tunes
games.desc: Falco Tunes - Весёлая аркада, где вам предстоит собирать ноты, и атаковать ими суровых зверей!

games.name: All Is Dust
games.desc: All Is Dust is a first-person horror game for PC and Oculus Rift. Experience the terror of a dust storm in the 1930s and unravel the mystery surrounding your decaying farm.

games.name: UNSEEN LAND: INTO THE MIST
games.desc: For centuries, Veridia thrived. Now, an otherworldly invader tears rifts, unleashing maddened beasts. In the chaos, you awaken—once a humble farmer and hunter. Take up the sword, wield your power, and save Veridia.

games.name: Golf Around 2
games.desc: Пришло время поиграть в гольф... 2! Безумный гольф для 16 игроков! Тактически используйте гранаты, оружие и перки, чтобы перемещаться по безумным картам. Повышайте уровень и улучшайте своего персонажа. Играйте на пользовательских картах!

games.name: Corpo Tale
games.desc: You play as Martin, a Senior Test Engineer, working in a Test Department and it is Monday, yes... the dreadful Monday. From the beginning of the game you embark on an epic quest to make sure that things actually start working.PLEASE NOTE THAT THE GAME IS NOT YET AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH!

games.name: DANGEROUS DUELS
games.desc: A local multiplayer game for 2-4 players. Only the fastest guns and the fastest on their feet can win!

games.name: Pretty Girls Panic! PLUS
games.desc: Popular Arcade Game "Pretty Girls Panic!" is back with more power. Expand the area steadily and dodge enemy attacks and avoid capture. There are 40 stages in total. Conquer all stages and Complete the rescue of these Pretty Girls.

games.name: Armored Firestorm
games.desc: Armored Firestorm is an intense top-down shoot'em up action game in a futurist environments. At the controls of your Hovertank, survive against the attack of the machines in the orbital city of the federation.

games.name: Bent Oak Island
games.desc: Bent Oak Island is a 1990's point and click adventure set on a mysterious island! Join twins Archer and Sam as they delve into the secrets of both the island and their own heritage, and maybe save the world!

games.name: The Third
games.desc: Двое восстали. Один всё ещё скрывается в тенях. Исследуйте проклятый храм, раскройте древние тайны и выживите в пугающем и захватывающем путешествии среди забытых богов и тьмы.

games.name: Clown House (Palyaço Evi)
games.desc: Freeware horror game with the mise en scène of an old black&white film and unique horror experience.

games.name: DinosaurIsland
games.desc: Авантюрная игра существования и избиения, приключенческие острые летальные искания, варить разные пищи, изготовить оружия, искать ресурсы, наслаждаться приключенческим путешествием. Жить и исследовать в темной сфере, всегда сохранять бдительность.

games.name: Book Of Yog Idle RPG 依盖之书
games.desc: The Book of Yog is a 3D idle RPG game presented with a Cel-Shading art style. You can rally heroes, develop the kingdom and explore the secrets of a lost world. Dozens of heroes, hundreds of skills, thousands of loot for you to combine freely. Come to embark on a journey to build the strongest team!

games.name: Unknown Signal
games.desc: Unknown Signal - приключенческая 3D-игра. Вы получили загадочный сигнал и вам предстоит узнать что или кто его послал.

games.name: Velvet Sundown
games.desc: Velvet Sundown is a social multiplayer role-playing game, taking place on a luxury yacht cruising the waters of a fictitious Caribbean state of Balbonia. Embark on a journey full of conspiracies, trickery and secrets where you can never tell a friend from foe.

games.name: Night Shift at the Gym
games.desc: Ночная смена в спортзале. Каждую ночь одни и те же 3 клиента. Одни и те же разговоры. Одни и те же заказы. Так почему же каждый раз становится страннее? После 4 ночей вы столкнётесь с правдой.

games.name: Crown and Council
games.desc: Crown and Council is a casual strategy game with short game sessions.

games.name: SYNTHETIK: Arena
games.desc: "Synthetik: Арена" - это скоростной шутер в мире будущего, которое не наступит. Окунись в мир ретрофутуризма, освой мощные технологии и пройди многочисленные испытания бога машин Zir. Пусть рефлексы тебя не подведут!

games.name: The Zone
games.desc: Dimitri has a mission: go to an island and disable all the electrical installations to avoid that strange creatures have multiplies and go out.

games.name: Missing Time
games.desc: An inheritance uproots you back to your hometown. Surrounded by mysteries and temptations, which path will you choose? A horror dating visual novel by Fluttering Abyss.

games.name: Splice
games.desc: A security job gone wrong. Now you are trapped with something deep inside an underground research bunker, and you are all that is left. Can you overcome your fear in this escape room horror?

games.name: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
games.desc: Start your own Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria with Freddy Fazbear Pizzeria Simulator!

games.name: MU Legend
games.desc: Following the footsteps of the successful titles MU Online and MU Origin, MU Legend offers an authentic alternative to the dungeon crawler gaming experience. A game with its own unique signature, MU Legend blends the dark fantasy world of an MMO with the richness of hack 'n' slash gaming.

games.name: Warhammer The Horus Heresy: Legions
games.desc: Собери колоду неукротимых космодесантников, чтобы завоевать галактику в жестоких поединках. Вновь переживи события «Ереси Гора» – оригинальной истории в мрачном будущем вселенной Warhammer 40000.

games.name: Spirit of Adventure
games.desc: "Spirit of Adventure" is a classical 2.5D dungeon crawl RPG game in which you'll take charge of a group of adventurers searching for the next callenge.

games.name: Swinging-Man
games.desc: Physics-based arcade game that will leave you in stitches and begging for more. Unleash your 'special web fluid' to swing across the city, defeat neuter drones, and collect adult magazines.

games.name: Aliens: Colonial Marines Collection
games.desc: Вы с друзьями — самые смертельно опасные убийцы в галактике, колониальные морпехи США. От вас требуется не просто выжить, но и уничтожить очаг распространения ксеноморфов.

games.name: CRSED: Cuisine Royale
games.desc: CRSED: Cuisine Royale — брутальный ММО-шутер на выживание с реалистичным оружием, элементами кровавой мистики и невероятными сверхспособностями.

games.name: ANARCHY
games.desc: ANARCHY - это игра на выживание и побег. Орда роботов, ловушек и прочего попытается убить вас. Сейчас это одна из самых сложных игр в STEAM.

games.name: Ohayou! Beginner's Japanese
games.desc: Ohayou! Beginner’s Japanese is an educational game that will teach you the basics of Japanese Hiragana and Katakana.

games.name: Neon Racer
games.desc: Endless road, neon lights, palm trees. The game immerses you in the atmosphere of retrowave. Welcome to Neon Racer! Neon Racer is a car simulator game in which you drive along the endless road and avoid other cars.

games.name: Puzzle Dungeon!! Earthmage Erin
games.desc: Puzzle Dungeon!! is a series of games where fantasy classes solve puzzles themed after their abilities! In Puzzle Dungeon!!: Earthmage Erin, play as Erin, an Earthmage with the power to control gravity. Solve 30+ puzzles in themed dungeons to rescue Erin's lost goats and bring them back to her farm.

games.name: 剑决
games.desc: 3d duel fight support local multiplayer.

games.name: Sabre Team
games.desc: Sabre Team is an isometric squad-level turn-based infiltration simulation that lets you assemble and take command of a Sabre Team unit of four hand-picked elite S.A.S. agents as they confront delicate and dangerous scenarios involving terrorist threats and hostage situations.

games.name: Champions of Regnum
games.desc: Choose your Realm and engage in the most dynamic player driven battlefield available on any MMO. Fight for the Alsius Empire, protect the woods of Syrtis or avenge the Brotherhood of Ignis.

games.name: Don't Leave
games.desc: Welcome to a mysterious adventure where justice and the supernatural intertwine! Judge Harlan, in his old country cottage, faces a mysterious presence after his mother's sudden departure. Explore justice's limits in this extraordinary tale!

games.name: Tactical Mind
games.desc: Become a Master of Pawns with your Tactical Mind!

games.name: Nora's AdventurEscape
games.desc: Do you seek an adventure? Maybe an escape from daily struggles? Find hidden objects, solve puzzles and escape rooms.

games.name: The House
games.desc: The House is a new first-person horror and psychological game for the computer. Escape the house where it all began, collect items, weapons and level up. Travel between worlds and time to reach your goal. Go discover the dark secrets of the House where it all began!

games.name: Complex 629
games.desc: Complex—психологическая играисследование в жанре ужасов действие которой происходит в многоквартирном доме в Исландии. Разгребайте снег голыми руками, чтобы избежать атаков Деда. Общайтесь с многочисленными персонажами, собирая деньги и полезные предметы для перемещения между заснеженными квартирами

games.name: NecroNomNomNom: Eldritch Horror Dating
games.desc: Plunge into the depths of sanity and Lovecraftian lore in this Eldritch Horror Dating Visual Novel. Will you find love or madness?

games.name: 孔明锁
games.desc: The game simulates the traditional Kongming lock game, which cleverly meshes the concave and convex parts inside the three-dimensional splicing tool.

games.name: Shadowtime
games.desc: To exist in the virtual world is to have two bodies, four hands, two hearts. In Shadowtime, a guide to this double world leads you through irreconcilable realities and through the virtual as a place to take shelter.

games.name: Skyforge
games.desc: Discover a universe of adventure in Skyforge, the sci-fi action MMO brought to you by Innova Co SARL. Explore the breathtaking world of Aelion, become an Immortal, switch between 18+ classes, and master amazing powers to defend the planet from invasion. Play for free today!

games.name: 与你启挚
games.desc: 本作是一款细腻温暖的轻百合向AVG视觉小说。故事围绕着长期遭受校园霸凌、在自卑与孤独中蜷缩的女高中生——夏目萤展开。当她的人生几乎被灰色笼罩时，一次偶然的相遇，让她结识了白铃学园里如光芒般存在的学生会长，早坂葵。这位与她性格截然不同的学姐，不仅以温柔与坚定将她从绝望中打捞，更亲手为她推开了一扇望向新世界的窗。游戏通过精美的CG、动人的音乐与沉浸式的叙事，邀请您一同见证这段关于欺凌、救赎与自我成长的青春物语。您的选择将引导夏目萤走向不同的结局——是延续仰望，还是最终并肩？这段破茧之旅，静候您的开启。

games.name: Rescue Team: Phantom Crisis
games.desc: По улицам отдаются эхом крики, техника внезапно выходит из строя, а в воздухе мелькают призрачные силуэты. Продержитесь до конца, раскройте правду и переживите неведомое… пока оно не поглотило всё.

games.name: King's Table - The Legend of Ragnarok
games.desc: In this modern take on an ancient board game similar to Chess, one side must defend Odin against an onslaught of attackers as he makes his escape to one of the corners of the board. Use sharp strategy and tactics to help Odin reach safety before he is caught defenseless between multiple assailants!

games.name: Trivia King
games.desc: Проверьте себя в Trivia King или играйте в режиме Party (до 4 игроков). 8 популярных категорий и тысячи вопросов с вариантами ответа.

games.name: SushiVR
games.desc: SushiVR is a VR game in which the player becomes a general of a sushi restaurant and holds the sushi as the customer wants one after another and provides them quickly.

games.name: Sapper
games.desc: A puzzle game in which you destroy castles with chain reactions of fire, collapses and explosions.

games.name: Wildlife Match
games.desc: Jungle animals are going missing and Agent Blonde is on the case! Help her and her friend, Professor Fox, get to the bottom of the mystery! Match fun animal shapes, complete missions and face down powerful monsters on your quest to save the jungle!

games.name: SønderDø
games.desc: You have to survive the night until 08:00/8 AM. The only thing you have by your side is your flashlight. It is especially hard to maneuver around the school since the teachers can hear you inside an area.

games.name: The Iron Union
games.desc: Greetings tank commander,and welcome to the《The Iron Union》.In this game,you will prove yourself by using your tanks to break though the blockade,and eliminate all your enemy.

games.name: Spleef Game
games.desc: Dig the blocks below the opposing player to make him fall... But don't fall yourself! As competitive as fun!

games.name: Jewel Legends: Atlantis
games.desc: In the Match-3 game "Jewel Legends - Atlantis" you have to discover the secrets of Atlantis and repair the magnificent city! Build rows of three or more symbols - you will have huge chains built before you know it! Collect ancient artifacts and secret treasures that you can use to build your city.

games.name: RED TREES RAIL. CO.
games.desc: Red Trees Rail Co is a VR Horror Train simulator set in a Redwood Forest. Work a tiny night train by yourself, transporting passengers from town to town.

games.name: Horror Camp
games.desc: Выживайте в лабиринте ужасов в стиле мультсериалов! Решайте головоломки, собирайте ресурсы и избегайте смертельных ловушек и ужасных монстров. Используйте всё, что найдете, чтобы разблокировать улучшения и повысить свои шансы на выживание. Но будьте осторожны... кто-то наблюдает за вами. Сможете ли вы выбраться…

games.name: Daemonsgate
games.desc: Experience Imagitec Design’s ambitious and innovative RPG, breathtaking in scope at over 150 hours of play time. Daemonsgate will draw you in with its richly detailed world, fascinating character interactions, and epic story.

games.name: Dreadnought
games.desc: Командуйте собственными флагманскими кораблями и настраивайте их. Уничтожайте врагов в грозном командном бою. Dreadnought — это free-to-play игра-шутер, которая перенесет вас в центр грандиозных сражений на космических кораблях.

games.name: Web Spice Purple World
games.desc: На планету снова напали, вы снова используете мемы, побеждаете и все такое, ура. Станьте мастером в борьбе со злом, используйте весь свой арсенал, и покажите, что ваша родная планета стоит того, что бы ее защищать.

games.name: Bikerz
games.desc: Bikerz is a fast-paced, action-packed game where you have only one goal: survive all of the coming levels!

games.name: Gunslingers of the Wasteland vs. The Zombies From Mars
games.desc: Do battle across the American Southwest in this This Third-Person Shooter as you contend with the evil Dr. Arcturis and his legion of undead.

games.name: Taivas
games.desc: Taivas is a mysterious action roguelite set in a world of myth, and a time of magic. The destiny of a Canidae Kingdom rests on the shoulders of a young fox alike boy. His name… Joakim. Use spells and special weapons to explore, destroy and fight your way to the UpWorld, and beyond...

games.name: Monkey Hit
games.desc: Go through long levels filled with various enemies and dangers.

games.name: Descension
games.desc: Descension is an OpenWorld Survival Horror Game That features constant new expansions and events. Survive For Six hours in uncharted universes, and get your exploration rewarded with a stronger arsenal!

games.name: 反击吧！NPC
games.desc: 一款回合制RPG游戏，可以鼠标点击操控，或者键盘上下左右空格操作，通过打怪升级，买装备变强，路人翻身做主角

games.name: Jim's Nightmare: Chapter 1
games.desc: Go ahead and take on this psychological point and click puzzle adventure. Uncover the truth behind Jim’s shady past, his current mental illness and his peerless journey to vanquish a madman!

games.name: Brain Freeze
games.desc: Detectives Cheese and Chalk are on the case in this story-driven, puzzle noir. Pick a lock, outline a “corpse,” and shoot at flying hell-rats as the plot thickens and twists more sickeningly than gas-station nacho cheese. I’m not crazy. You’re crazy.

games.name: Akhena: Age of Evil
games.desc: Akhena: Age of Evil is an open-world RPG where the player can explore a vast and dangerous world with a rich history rooted in gritty realism and filled with riches to discover. The story and characters are inspired by classic fantasy novels, where morality is nuanced and defined by cultural bias.

games.name: Revelations
games.desc: Revelations is a zombies passion project created solely by me, Brock de Beaubien. It's heavily inspired by bo2 and bo3 zombies.

games.name: Calm Before the Storm
games.desc: Calm Before the Storm — это ретро-симулятор уборки в японском стиле.

games.name: Ryzom
games.desc: Enter a unique science fantasy MMORPG and dive into a unique organic living world !

games.name: Veilscripture AI
games.desc: Veilscripture — Roleplay with characters that are yours. On your machine. No one watching.

games.name: Ball Pool Simulator
games.desc: Ballpool Simulator is a casual physics-based game where thousands of balls roll, bounce, and collide in colorful chaos. Blast them with bombs, trigger chain reactions, and chase high scores. Upgrade power, time, and ball count to create even more explosive fun!

games.name: Aftermath Y2K
games.desc: Inspired by such games as Castlevania and Ninja Gaiden; aftermath is a NES styled action platformer. However in Aftermath you play as a dog. You must run, jump, and dodge your way through 8 levels to recover your beloved owner. All the while also trying to fend off thugs, bandits, henchmen, and mutants.

games.name: CosmicBreak Universal
games.desc: CosmicBreak Universal is an MMO action game that lets you play massive battles of up to 30 vs 30 players using customizable robots and humanoids! Create your own original character and aim for victory with your allies!

games.name: Freon
games.desc: Freon - это кооперативный шутер на двоих, напоминающий старые добрые пиксельные игры. Наслаждайтесь игрой с друзьями или членами семьи.

games.name: Witches of the Fourth Multiplayer
games.desc: Witches of the Fourth 2.0 Is An Online Multiplayer Spell Casting TeamBase FPS Witch Hunt Where You Duel Against Your Friends Using Powerful Spells and Magical Abilities to Collect There Souls The Player With the Most Souls Win Witches of the Fourth is the Battle Between Black Magic and Core Magic

games.name: Vowel Movements
games.desc: In Vowel Movements you race against the clock to group words together into categories. The only catch is that each of the vowels has been replaced by a different vowel. Surely that can’t make things too difficult…

games.name: Junk Blocks
games.desc: Это расслабляющая игра для снятия головоломки. Игрок должен перетащить квадрат на шахматную доску, заполнить всю строку или целый столбец, чтобы удалить его. Будьте осторожны с « кубиками Junk», которые будут препятствовать вашему процессу и должны быть очищены с помощью комбинации тройного гашения.

games.name: Escape from exit 7 of the theater
games.desc: You're stuck in an infinite loop in the theater. You must escape to exit 7 to open the hidden door. Go forward and find the hidden door.

games.name: Market master Simulator
games.desc: Добро пожаловать в Market Master Simulator! Управляйте своим супермаркетом, производите и продавайте товары, оптимизируйте энергоэффективность. Испытайте свои управленческие навыки, чтобы сделать свой рынок процветающим торговым центром.

games.name: SUPER_HASHIGO
games.desc: The controls used during the game are a simple operation with only two keys: "Forward" and "Backward." However, it offers a highly challenging experience. Dodge various gimmicks and aim for the top of "HASHIGO"!

games.name: Flower Escape
games.desc: A local 2 player leveler game

games.name: Thornwood Palace
games.desc: A cute-but-creepy 2D puzzle platformer where you explore the haunted Thornwood Palace in search of your lost brother. Survive traps, animated household horrors, and unravel the mansion's dark secrets in this linear adventure.

games.name: Banished Souls
games.desc: Banished Souls is a chilling paranormal investigation game where every haunting is unpredictable. Explore cursed relics, decipher deadly symbols, and uncover the Room of Death. Only by revealing the ghost’s true identity and banishing it can you survive.

games.name: Thinky Wants To Guess
games.desc: Рисуйте простые наброски и смотрите, сможет ли ИИ угадать, что это. Thinky Wants To Guess — это расслабляющая игра про рисование, где ваша креативность проверяется ИИ, пытающимся понять ваши каракули.

games.name: Cube Racer
games.desc: Cube Racer is a round based multiplayer racing game with cubes. Every round, all players race against each other to the finish line. Before every round, the players get to build one or more obstacles on the map. In the next round, all players have to pass all the obstacles, which have been built yet.

games.name: Himno
games.desc: Himno is a peaceful, 2D platformer game with an infinite number of beautiful procedurally generated maps. Take a breath, and relax.
